decision: B — ANALYTICALLY PROMISING, BUT A GENUINE MISSING LEMMA REMAINS TO BE PROVED.
justification: Primary-source check of Lei-Ren-Tian (arXiv:2501.08976) reveals that Theorem 1.1 handles M > 0 using time evolution of a fixed axis e, while Corollary 1.6 handles moving e(t) only when M = 0. The hybrid (e(t) + M > 0) is not proved by the paper and faces genuine obstructions: omega . e'(t) in time evolution and 2D slice interface defects beyond O(M r^2) mass smallness.
next_mission: Proof-only adversarial mathematical audit to determine whether time-slice pairwise alignment for |omega| > M implies regularity or what exact temporal/interface hypothesis is required.
